name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.169: Release commits carry the maintainer's own identity.
    The release script forced "SubDL Scribe <noreply@localhost>" on the commit that
    writes the manifest, so every release produced one commit that belonged to nobody:
    GitHub attributed it to no account, the contributor list showed a second author next
    to the maintainer, and thirteen commits carried a name the maintainer never wrote.
    The override is gone - the commit inherits the repository's identity, which is the
    account's verified address, so one author stands behind the whole history.
    No plugin behaviour change; the release process and the artifact are untouched.
